constraints: Diagnostic, not a checksum-gate replacement. Never normalizes or patches either image. Without --expected it compares against original retail including known exception padding.
name: r62-enemy-link-audit
purpose: Read-only complete DOL comparison for compiled-enemy linkage, including headers, padding, layouts and every loaded byte.
usage: Pass --built and --expected; the expected cleaned build must satisfy config/GUNE5D/build.sha1. Output includes both image digests.
